name: Vardhman Holdings Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1962, Vardhman Holdings Ltd is in the business of lending and investing activities[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
VHL is a Non Deposit Taking Systemically Important Non Banking Finance Corporation which is mainly into investment activities. It primarily earns its income from investments. Company’s strategy is to adopt a systematic approach of investment into different asset classes and to keep the portfolio dynamic as per the changing market conditions. Company’s current portfolio consists of investments into debt, equity and real estate

pros: Stock is trading at 0.31 times its book value
Market value of investments Rs.3,728 Cr. is more than the Market Cap Rs.1,176 Cr.
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 299 days to 91.6 days
cons: Company has a low return on equity of 7.03% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.246 Cr.
Dividend payout has been low at 0.73% of profits over last 3 years
